# shuhratjon1010.github.io

> Home of HandCut, a captions-first iPhone video editor: word-by-word captions transcribed on the device, a real timeline, 4K export and never a watermark. Edit free; exporting needs HandCut Pro, a monthly subscription priced in the app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762062166
